summary: Red-teamed plan.md. Top risks: (1) $95 MRR by Day 30 is not reachable because only trials from about Nov 12-18 can convert, and the Day-14 and activation kill triggers fire at the wrong time; (2) PH launch with no evidence of a working, beta-tested app or validated demand, and too much owner work in one week; (3) the free 3-proposal cap may cover the beachhead (2-6 briefs a month) while Pro adds nothing defined, so trials end in a downgrade. Proposed changes: an activation-based Day-30 goal, a beta gate before PH, and Pro-vs-Free as a hard blocker. Note: O19 was not present in tasks.json (empty).

experiments.hypothesis: The median beachhead freelancer sends more than 3 proposals a month, so the free cap pushes users toward Pro.
experiments.metric: median self-reported proposals sent per month across G33 interviews (last 2 months)

experiments.hypothesis: A closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users can each send one real proposal (signature plus deposit request) before any public launch.
experiments.metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent to a real client before the go/no-go date
